description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'PolicyModificationInvalidException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project. The class is thrown when modifications to a policy would result in an invalid policy state. It includes factory methods for creating instances with specific messages, JSON deserialization, and a builder pattern for customization. The class is annotated as immutable and serializable, and it implements the PolicyException interface.
